quests.title: Returns at Como
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I am sending back 65 papers a day from Como and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Como
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. They will drop my Como order if I can show $50 of turnover on the other side of the shop by grand final week. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $50, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Como Round
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I do the Como round from the second express and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Como
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. There is a dog on the Como round that has had two of my bags and a whiteboard with last March still on it that was not even mine. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Como
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Nine of us at Como have gone in on the same numbers since grand final week and one of us has stopped putting money in. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$65, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Como
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The agency at Jannali closed six months before Como started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Bankstown
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. There has been a car in the Bankstown yard since every second Friday with a chest freezer that hums in D on the passenger seat and no owner answering. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Bankstown
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Now that it is documented, Bankstown is owed $68 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $68, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Bankstown
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I am in my first year at Bankstown and I have to log 26 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Bankstown
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Somebody has been coming into the Bankstown yard after ten past five to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Bankstown
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. My car has been at Bankstown since every second Friday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $26. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Bankstown
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Bankstown works out of Yagoona, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Clyde
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. People leave things at the Clyde roller door after first light and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. I am aware how that sounds. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Clyde
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The photos worked, which means Clyde can claim back the $65 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since grand final week. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: $65, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Clyde
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Something came into Clyde on grand final week in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Clyde
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Two people have been coming into the Clyde sorting room since grand final week and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$30, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Clyde
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I do the Clyde pick-ups in a van with 30 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: come out to Granville with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Clyde
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Everything Clyde cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Harris Park, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
